full_judgment:
Mr. Bijan Kilmer Das. J.:- This appeal at the instance of the plaintiff's directed against the' judgment and decree dated 19.2.91 passed by the subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Mymensingh in Money suit No. 45 of 1990. 

 2. The facts, in short, are that the appellant as plaintiff instituted Money suit no 11 of 1987. Subsequently the suit was transferred to the court of the subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Mymensingh and was renumbered as Money suit No. 45 of 1990 impleading the respondents as defendants praying for a decree for recovery of Tk. 4,05,481.00 against the defendants alleging inter alia, that the plaintiff granted Cash Credit Loan limit of Tk. 50,000/- defendants 1&2 on 31.08.84 with 15% interest per annum with quarterly rests and the interest was subsequently enhanced at Tk. 20% and that the defendant executed documents including deed of mortgage in favour of the Bank. Subsequently the aforesaid Cash Credit limit was enhanced at Tk. 75,000/- on 14,11.84 on condition as aforesaid. The plaintiff further asserts that the defendants 1&2by influencing defendant No.3 took excess drawing of huge amount from the bank and the defendant No.3 was dismissed from service for granting such excess drawing. The plaintiff alleged that the' outstanding liability in the account of defendant No. 1 stood at Tk. 4.05 841.00 as on 31-12-86 and the plaintiff requested the defendants No.1 and his brother pressed him hard and salish held in the house of the superintendent of Krishnapur Aliya Madrasha and the defendant no. 3 admitted before the salishdars that he took money from both the accounts of defendant No 1 and his brother Nurul Amin amounting to Tk. 53,500/- Accordingly he agreed to repay the entire amount and executed an undertaking on 29.10.85 in his own house in presence of witnesses. The defendants contended that the defendant No.3 had withdrawn the excess amount from the bank by signing the bank cheque kept with him by the defendant No. 1 and the defendants 1 8/ 2 are not liable for the said amount and it was 'further stated that a criminal case being Khulna PS case No. 8 dated 6.12.85 was filed against the defendant No.3 and a charge sheet was submitted against him in the said criminal case on the finding of a prima facie case of defalcation of the bank's money defendants 3 to settle the outstanding .loan by obtaining money from defendant no. 1 but without any result and that despite service of Legal notice dated 30-08-86 the defendants 1 & 2 did not repay the loan but only deposited an amount of Tk. 2000/- on 4.11.85 and executed a balance confirmation certificate and admitted the outstanding loan at Tk. 3,35,269.36 and also executed a D.P. Note . The plaintiff states that all the defendants are liable to pay the outstanding amount Of Tk. 4,05,841.00 with .20% interest till payment and accordingly filed the suit. 

 7. The trial Court framed necessary is use and on consideration of the documentary evidence found that the excess drawing from the account of the defendant no 1 was admitted. The question was whether the defendants 1 & 2 are responsible for the over drawing or the defendant. No. 3 is responsible for the over drawing. The trail Court noticed that the defendants 1 & 2 alleged that the defendant No. 3 alone is responsible for the over drawing while the defendant no 3 asserted that the defendants 1 & 2 are responsible for the overdrawing. The trial Court considered the evidences both oral and documentary and came to a finding that the amount of Tk.. 69,950/-allegedly deposited on 14.2.84 29.4.84, 29.4.83; 27.04.84 15.2.84 and 13.2:84 were in fact not deposited in the account of the defendant No.1 and the statement of account submitted also do not show that the said amount was deposited on the said dates. The trial Court considered the evidence of P.W.1 and the evidence of D.W. 1, 2. 3 & 4 and held that the defendant No. 3 'executed the deed of undertaking on 29.10.85 and admitted that he had withdrawn the amount in question as over drawing from the account of the defendant No.1 and accordingly concluded that the defendant No: 3' was liable for the repayment of the amount iii quest on and the defendants 1 & 2 are not liable for the said amount. Accordingly- by the judgment and decree dated 19.2.91 the trail court dismissed the suit without cost against defendants 1 & 2 and decreed the suit with cost against defendant no 3 directing him to pay Tk. 4,05,841.00 to as the plaintiff. 

 8. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and. decree dismissing the suit against the defendants 1 & 2 the plaintiff as appellant has filed the present appeal. 

 9. Mr. M.A. Tariq, the learned Advocate appearing for the appellant submits that the trial court committed gross error in failing to hold that amount in question was withdrawn from the account of the defendant No. 1 & 2 are also jointly and severally liable for the amount in question along with the defendant No. 3 Mr. Tariq submits that upon a correct reading Of the evidence, both oral and documentary, decree may be passed as against the defendants I & 2 also making them liable jointly and severally to repay the bank money. 

 17. For the forgoing reasons, this appeal is dismissed without any order as to cost. The impugned judgment and decree dated 19.2.91 passed by the subordinate judge and Artha Rin Adalat, Mymensingh in Money Suit No:45 of 1990 are nearby affirmed. Send down the lower court records at once.
